title: Use after free in Quota in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Quota component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the browser's sandbox by crafting a malicious HTML page. The vulnerability is classified with high severity by Chromium security.
